![]()

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)
####### Data cleaning ########
# hit_type (1B, !B, and 1b)
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(
    hit_type = str_trim(hit_type),
    hit_type = na_if(hit_type, ""), # "" -> NA
    hit_type = str_to_upper(hit_type), # 1b -> 1B
    hit_type = recode(hit_type, '!B' = "1B") # str_to_upper changes !b to !B.
  )
#sort(unique(df$hit_type)) #Check datas were cleaned correctly


# Total Hit Records
## Total At Bat
total_at_bat_b <- df %>% 
  filter(event %in% c("HIT",'OUT', 'E', 'K')) %>% 
  count(player_name, name = "AB") %>% 
  arrange(desc(AB))

## Total rbi
total_rbi_b <- df %>% 
  group_by(player_name) %>% 
  summarise(rbi_b = sum(rbi, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(rbi_b))

## Total 1B 
total_one_base_b <- df %>% 
  filter(hit_type == '1B') %>% 
  mutate(one_b_b = hit_type == '1B', '1b', '!b') %>% 
  group_by(player_name) %>% 
  summarise(single = sum(one_b_b)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(single))

## Total 2B 
total_two_base_b <- df %>% 
  filter(hit_type == '2B') %>% 
  mutate(two_b_b = hit_type == '2B') %>% 
  group_by(player_name) %>% 
  summarise(double = sum(two_b_b, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(double))

#total_two_base_b

## Total 3B 
total_three_base_b <- df %>% 
  filter(hit_type == '3B') %>% 
  mutate(three_b_b = hit_type == '3B') %>% 
  group_by(player_name) %>% 
  summarise(triple = sum(three_b_b, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(triple))

#total_three_base_b

## Total HR 
total_hr_base_b <- df %>% 
  filter(hit_type == 'HR') %>% 
  mutate(hr_b = hit_type == 'HR') %>% 
  group_by(player_name) %>% 
  summarise(hr = sum(hr_b, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(hr))

## Count the game 
total_games <- df %>% 
  group_by(player_name) %>% 
  summarise(game = n_distinct(game_id), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(desc(game))

#total_games

#total_hr_base_b

## CALUCULATE THE OPS -> SLG + OBP
at_bat <- df %>% 
  mutate(rem_sac = (event == "OUT") & !is.na(rbi) & (rbi >= 1) & (field_pos %in% c(7,8,9)), # Remove scrify fly 
         total_ab = event %in% c("HIT",'OUT', 'E', 'K') & !rem_sac, # Remove BB, and Db and Sacrify fly
         hit = event == 'HIT',
         one_base = hit_type == '1B',
         two_base = hit_type == '2B',
         three_base = hit_type == '3B',
         hr = hit_type == 'HR',
         bb = event == 'BB',
         db = event == 'DB') %>%
  group_by(player_name) %>% 
  summarise(
    game = n_distinct(game_id), .groups = "drop",
    AB_b = sum(total_ab, na.rm = TRUE),
    HIT_b = sum(hit, na.rm = TRUE),
    AV_b = HIT_b/AB_b,
    RBI_b = sum(rbi, na.rm = TRUE),
    One_b = sum(one_base, na.rm = TRUE),
    Double_b = sum(two_base, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Triple_b = sum(three_base, na.rm = TRUE),
    Hr_b = sum(hr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Bb_b = sum(bb, na.rm = TRUE),
    Db_b = sum(db, na.rm = TRUE),
    SF_b = sum(rem_sac, na.rm = TRUE),
    TB_b = One_b*1 + Double_b*2 + Triple_b*3 + Hr_b*4,
    SLG = TB_b/AB_b, #SLG
    OBP = (HIT_b + Bb_b + Db_b) / (AB_b + Bb_b + SF_b + Db_b),
    OPS = SLG + OBP
    
    ) %>% 
  arrange(desc(game))

#at_bat

####### hightlight the quarify player #########
qualify_player <- at_bat %>% 
  mutate(hightlight = AB_b >= 69) # 30 * 2.3 = 69
## game_id distinct() * 2.3 = ?


### Rename the columns name
hits_tbale_rename <- qualify_player %>% 
  rename(
    Player = player_name,
    AB = AB_b, 
    H = HIT_b,
    AVG = AV_b,
    RBI = RBI_b,
    Single = One_b,
    Double = Double_b,
    Triple = Triple_b,
    HR = Hr_b,
    BB = Bb_b,
    HBP = Db_b,
    SF = SF_b,
  )

game_stats <- hits_tbale_rename %>% 
  select(!c(TB_b, hightlight))

### Display the 3 decimal on AVG, OPS etc...
three_decimal <- function(x) {
  out <- ifelse(is.na(),"",sprintf("%.3f", x))
  out <- ifelase(out != "" & 1 < x & x >= 0, sub("^0", "", x), out)
  out
} 
  



###### Create a Table ######
kable(game_stats, caption = "Total Stats for basedball (軟式）and softball", booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kableExtra::row_spec(which(qualify_player$hightlight), background = "slategray1") %>% 
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "basic", "hover")
  ) %>% 
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "slategray1", background = "blue") %>%   column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, color = "slategray1", background = "blue") %>% 
  footnote(general = "This order based on HIT")

```

```{r}
#install.packages("kableExtra")

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# Total hits for BOTH
hits_both <- df %>%
  filter(event == "HIT") %>%
  count(player_name, name = "total hit")

# Total hits for SOFTBALL
hits_softball <- df %>%
  filter(event == "HIT", sport == "s") %>%
  count(player_name, name = "total_hit_softball")

# Total hits for BASEBALL
hits_baseball <- df %>%
  filter(event == "HIT", sport == "b") %>%
  count(player_name, name = "total_hit_baseball")

# Combine into one table (include players with 0 too)
hits_table <- df %>%
  distinct(player_name) %>%
  left_join(hits_both, by = "player_name") %>%
  left_join(hits_softball, by = "player_name") %>%
  left_join(hits_baseball, by = "player_name") %>%
  mutate(
    `total hit` = replace_na(`total hit`, 0),
    total_hit_softball = replace_na(total_hit_softball, 0),
    total_hit_baseball = replace_na(total_hit_baseball, 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(`total hit`))

hits_table


```

```{r}

kable(
  hits_table,
  caption = "Total Hits (Both / Softball / Baseball)"
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")
  ) %>% 
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "azure", background = "#6495ED") %>% 
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, color = "darkcyan") %>% 
  footnote(general = "THis is a general footnote")
```
